supporting_observations.claim: Repeated authentication failures for svc-render originate from FILE-NWD-01, use the same reported source IP (10.40.20.20), and recur roughly once per minute from 13:32 through 13:47. The FILE-NWD-01 events report bad-password substatus 0xc000006a.
Domain-controller records corroborate failed svc-render authentication from FILE-NWD-01, including NTLM validation failures and Kerberos pre-authentication failures.

A separate event on WS-NBLAKE-01 records PowerShell running as SYSTEM using explicit credentials for svc-render with PROXY-NWD-01 as the target server. This differs from the repeated failures reported from FILE-NWD-01 and is not explained by the supplied records.

The regular failures from FILE-NWD-01 are consistent with the supplied context that svc-render re-authenticates each minute and its password was scheduled for rotation at 13:30, potentially leaving the job with stale credentials. This does not explain the separate PowerShell credential-use event on WS-NBLAKE-01.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied records end at 13:47:38 UTC, so they do not cover the full requested 13:20–14:20 UTC interval.
The records show authentication failures and an explicit-credential event, but do not show whether the credential use on WS-NBLAKE-01 succeeded or what PowerShell command was executed.
claims_not_established: Whether svc-render's password was actually rotated at 13:30 and whether the RenderQueue job was updated afterward.
Whether the WS-NBLAKE-01 PowerShell process or its use of svc-render credentials was authorized.
Whether the credential use targeting PROXY-NWD-01 resulted in successful authentication or any proxy activity.
Whether any other successful svc-render logons or subsequent actions occurred during the full review window.
additional_evidence_needed: Endpoint process and PowerShell logs for WS-NBLAKE-01 around 13:36 UTC, including parent process, command line or script content, and user/session context.
PROXY-NWD-01 authentication and web-proxy logs around 13:36 UTC to determine whether svc-render authenticated and what activity followed.
FILE-NWD-01 service/job configuration and relevant process telemetry to verify the RenderQueue schedule, credential update, and source of the recurring authentication attempts.
Domain-controller authentication records and endpoint telemetry covering the remainder of 13:20–14:20 UTC, including any successful logons for svc-render.
Change or administrative records confirming the svc-render password rotation and whether the WS-NBLAKE-01 activity was authorized.
